verdict.rationale: Cognee is a memory engine whose documented capabilities are ingestion, retrieval, enrichment and deletion (remember/recall/improve/forget), plus a CLI and UI for asking questions. The evidence does not document a built-in assistant inside Cognee's own UI or Cloud that users hand tasks to. The closest item is a Linear agent that answers @mentions and delegated issues, but that assistant lives inside Linear as an integration, which is an adjacent feature rather than an in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
